newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Treasury names agents for Eni sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy Treasury names agents for Eni sale.

text.p: The Italian Treasury issued a list of managers for the international placement of a second tranche of shares in energy group Eni SpA due in October.
The Treasury has already named Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino and Banca Commerciale Italiano as joint lead managers for the operation and IMI as lead manager.
IMI, Istituto Mobiliare Italiano, was lead manager for the first tranche offer last November when an initial 15 percent of Eni was floated.
IMI and CS First Boston have already been appointed as joint global coordinators for the operation as they were for the first tranche placement.

The Treasury said in a statement on Friday that for the placement in the United States, CS First Boston would be bookrunning lead manager with Goldman Sachs as co-lead manager. JP Morgan, Lehman Brothers and Smith Barney were named as co-managers with ABN AMRO Rothschild and RBC Dominion Securities as junior co-managers.

For Britain, SBC Warburg will be bookrunning lead manager and CS First Boston, IMI, ABN AMRO Rothschild and NatWest Markets co-lead managers. Cazenove, Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino and J Henry Schroder will be co-managers.

For other international areas, the Treasury said Morgan Stanley will be bookrunning lead manager. CS First Boston, IMI, ABN AMRO Rothschild, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Nomura and Paribas will be co-lead managers. Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, Banque Indosuez, Creditanstalt, Daiwa and Robert Fleming will be co-managers.
